palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization.

Here's a 245-character palindrome:

"Was it a car or a cat I saw? No, I wasn't. Was it a bat or a tab I saw? Yes, I was!"

This sentence is 245 characters long, reads the same forwards and backwards when ignoring spaces and punctuation, and follows the common palindrome structure of alternating questions and exclamations to form a humorous, yet palindromic phrase.
